name: Study buddy
oneLine: Your notes become a quiz you can play.
forWho: Students and anyone with a test coming up who has notes but no time to make flashcards.
youGet: A quiz that asks why, not just what
Missed questions come back until they stick
woah: It brings back the ones you got wrong, like a tutor.
whyBetter: Plain Claude asks easy recall questions, adds facts your notes never said, and forgets your misses. This sticks to your notes and drills misses.
tryPrompt: Use the Study buddy skill. Here are my notes, make me a quiz: [paste your notes]
